short: The formative era of classical Greek culture, seeing the rise of the polis, the spread of Greek colonies, and the birth of philosophy.
full: The Archaic Period was a time of massive expansion and innovation. The Greek population recovered, city-states (poleis) like Athens and Sparta developed their distinct characters, and Greeks colonized shores from the Black Sea to Italy. It saw the introduction of coinage, the first Olympic Games, and the beginnings of monumental stone architecture and philosophical inquiry.
